rule: Four task types: habit (plus/minus), daily (checkbox + streak), todo (one-shot + checklist), reward (costs currency, no value change).
mimo_mapping: روتین روزانه: عادت / روزانه / کار امروز / پاداش

rule: Default task: priority=1 (Easy), value=0, attribute=str; reward starts at value=10; daily streak starts at 0.
Priority multipliers: Trivial 0.1, Easy 1, Medium 1.5, Hard 2 (per API enum), applied to delta/EXP/GP/HP.
task.value clamped to [MIN_TASK_VALUE=-47.27, MAX_TASK_VALUE=21.27] before delta.
delta = 0.9747 ** clamp(task.value), signed by direction: up=+delta, down=-delta; unchecking reverses the same delta.
Checklist partial credit: daily down and todo up scale delta by completed/total (and by 1/total when shrinking); scores can be split.
exp += round(delta * (1 + INT*0.025) * priority * crit * 6); INT bonus only when positive delta.
gp += ceil(delta * priority * crit * (1 + PER*0.02) * streakBonus); streakBonus = currStreak/100 + 1 (min +1).
mimo_mapping: شمارندهٔ سکهٔ روتین (جدا از سکههای Learn)

rule: On down: hp += delta * (1 - min(CON,100)/250 clamped >=0.1) * priority * 2, result at most -1; hp bounded by MAX_HEALTH=50.
mimo_mapping: نوار سلامت خیلی کم رنگ، بدون RPG

rule: crit chance = 0.03 * (1 + STR/100); crit multiplier = 1.5 + (4*STR)/(STR+200); deterministic predictableRandom(user).
predictableRandom uses a deterministic sin-based seed from user id + task id + date, so scoring is reproducible (no real RNG).
mimo_mapping: منطق قابل تکرار، بدون شانس واقعی

rule: toNextLevel(lvl) = 25*lvl for lvl<5; 150 at lvl=5; round((lvl^2*0.25 + 10*lvl + 139.75)/10)*10 afterwards.
On crossing toNextLevel: level+1, HP restored to 50, XP subtracts threshold, +1 stat point (capped 100).
mimo_mapping: افزایش سطح، بدون بنر پر زرقوبرق

rule: diminishingReturns(bonus,max,halfway=max/2) = max*bonus/(bonus+halfway): higher bonuses saturate.
MP gain on positive delta, capped by statsComputed(user).maxMP; used for skill unlocks (not exposed in Mimo skin).
mimo_mapping: فقط ثبت شده؛ در UI نمیآید

rule: Completing a daily increments its streak; each 21 consecutive days grants an achievement; cron resets streaks for missed dailies.
Perfect Day (all dailies done) grants a buff / achievement; MP buffer = max(10, 0.1*maxMP) * dailyChecked/(dailyDueUnchecked + dailyChecked).
Cron applies missed-daily damage at dayStart (custom dayStart, multiDaysCountAsOneDay=true); HP loss uses same priority scaling.
mimo_mapping: منطق پسزمینه، بدون اعلان پر سر و صدا

rule: Reward task: gp -= value (default 10), no delta/EXP/HP change; value stays constant.
All Habitica-derived rules live ONLY inside data-screen=routine; they are not wired to exam scores, leaderboard XP, Learn coins or lesson progress.
